ecr.title: Fiber Array Unit KVP-FAU-2408 - change Rev A to Rev B (32 channels incl. 4 PM laser inputs, 2 x MPO-16 APC male, +3,000 pcs)
ecr.reason: The Gen 2 CPO engine moves to 14 data lanes per direction and an external laser source (ELS): the laser light enters the PIC through four polarisation-maintaining fibres at both ribbon edges. The fibre count grows from 24 to 32 and the connector changes to two MPO-16 APC (pinned on the FAU side) to match the switch front-panel shuffle. Forecast increased.
ecr.agreed_effectivity: Samples and Lot 1 (PO lines 1.1 / 1.2, 500 pcs, material in production) delivered to Rev A0 / customer Rev A; Rev B0 / customer Rev B from Lot 2 (PO line 1.3) onwards.

changes.title: Channel count 24 -> 32 (two 16-fibre ribbons)
changes.reason: Gen 2 engine: 14 data lanes per direction + 4 laser inputs
changes.lpc: Feasible. New 32-groove substrate (6.0 x 8.0 mm, 5 weeks) and fused-silica lid 6.0 x 5.0 mm; arrays wider than 4.5 mm need the wide-array polishing fixture with centre support (+20 % polish time, LPC-LL-003 DR-13) and an incoming cumulative-pitch check. No 16-fibre ribbon is stocked: ribbons are made in-house from loose G.657.A2 fibre. Boot 9.0 x 4.5 x 16 mm (new).
changes.cost: Approx. + USD 13 per pc full cost (substrate, lid, in-house ribbonizing, +8 min assembly / polish / test); NRE fixtures USD 7,200
changes.schedule: Substrate 5 weeks - B0 from Lot 2; risk buy at ECR approval
